Features

What Cast Your Line does.

Three things, in order: keep the trip, find it again, and look back on the year. Available now for Mac. iPhone and iPad coming soon.

Fishing journal

Trips, catches, tackle, gear, weather, notes, photos, and who came along. Search your trips and browse by calendar, water, or species.

Fishing journal

GPS and maps

Your waters and places with their trip history, and a map of where you fished each year. Route recording comes with the iPhone and iPad app.

GPS and maps

Recaps and books

A recap for every year and month you fish, and a keepsake PDF book you can save or print yourself.

Recaps and books

Private, and priced plainly.

  • No account required
  • No feed or leaderboards
  • Works offline
  • Syncs through your own iCloud
  • Ten trips free, every feature included
  • $19.99 once, or $1.99 a month
